reviews.title: Good daisy chain fans but the wires are still really short.
reviews.comment: Fans that I attached to a Fractal Design Pop XL Silent PC case. The fans are pretty powerful, reaching an RPM of around 1600 or so and aren't too loud. My problem with these fans are that the daisy chain plug is SUPER SHORT. I'm talking so short the fans need to be next to each other entirely for you to chain them together. The plug that goes to the motherboard/fan hub are not to long either, though the fans do come with their own extension cords. Installation wasn't too big of an issue aside from the screws, which keep trying to go sideways due to misalignment. But they work, and they work well. recommended as a standalone fan, not so much as a daisy chain fan.
reviews.author: Carlos Canales
